name: repairlearning
description: Learn while Claude works: short facts and yes/no questions about PHP, JavaScript and Git, in English or French, in the band above the prompt, paused whenever Claude needs you.

french.title: Cartes en français (French cards)
french.description: Show the cards, the band and the summaries in French. Off: English.

ai_cards.title: Write new cards with a model
ai_cards.description: Generate cards for whatever this session is about, such as Rust or Kubernetes, instead of only the shipped JavaScript, PHP and Git packs. Sends the topic name to Claude in the background and uses your plan.

daily_goal.title: Daily goal
daily_goal.description: Cards per day before RepairLearning goes quiet.

max_per_turn.title: Cards per turn
max_per_turn.description: Most cards shown during one Claude turn.
